author: Vertyco
description: A hungry-hippos style marble game for ActivityHub. Up to four players stretch their hippos out to munch the most marbles, computer hippos fill the empty seats so one player can start a round alone, and a global leaderboard ranks everyone by wins. Works on desktop and on phones held either way. It is also the worked multiplayer example for ActivityHub's DEVELOPERS.md. Needs ActivityHub 0.1.9 or later.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each player's Discord user ID, Discord display name, and their Marble Munch wins, marbles eaten and rounds played, for the global leaderboard.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Marble Munch!

Marble Munch is a game for ActivityHub, which must be installed and set up first:
`[p]repo add vrt-cogs https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs`
`[p]cog install vrt-cogs activityhub`
`[p]load activityhub`
Then follow ActivityHub's README: https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs/blob/main/activityhub/README.md

Once both are loaded, Marble Munch shows up in the hub's menu.
short: A hungry-hippos style marble game for ActivityHub
